IS 4332 : Part 5 : 1970 Methods of test for stabilizd soils: Part 5 Determination of unconfined compressive strength of stablized soilsUDC 624.138 : 624.131.376CED 43Reaffirmed 20201. SCOPE1.1 This standard (Part V) covers the determination of the unconfined compressive strength of stabilized soil specimens made with fine and medium grained soils. It covers the preparation and testing of cylindrical specimens prepared to a pre-determined dry density or with a constant compactive effort. The method in which the specimens are prepared to a constant dry density is preferred and should be used whenever possible.
